quiz_plan.promise: the quiz plays the page's promise: a spelling quiz a visitor can take, whose results answer what the H1 says it builds

plan.angle: Every result in the top 10 is a spelling quiz to take (Merriam-Webster's Spell It, SpellQuiz, Britannica, Studiosity, EnglishClub, Fact Monster) and only ESL Desk offers a basic builder. This page gives the searcher both: an 8-word pick-the-right-spelling quiz to play on the page, with a dictionary source behind each answer, then four spelling quizzes a teacher, a club coach and a recruiter run as their own app, each saving every typed or chosen spelling to a table that shows which words and which rules to teach again.
tab_stories: Pellbridge Elementary gives 48 third graders in 2 classes a 15-word pretest each Monday, each child practices only the words they missed, and the number who spelled all 15 rose from 7 on Monday to 29 on Friday.
The Duskmoor Middle School spelling bee club of 18 types each word from a definition and a sentence in 25-word rounds, and the top 4 scorers, led by Isla Lunden with 24 of 25, go to the district bee.

A 5th-grade class of 27 at Bellcroft Elementary takes a 20-word quiz where every word is tagged with its spelling rule, and doubling the final consonant, missed by 14 of 27, becomes next week's mini-lesson.

Ozwell Staffing gives front-desk applicants a 20-word check of office words such as receive and schedule, a score of 17 or more passes, the recruiter gets an email for each pass, and 41 of 64 applicants passed last month.
